scripts.tauri:dev: cd apps/desktop && bunx tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --features dev-instance
scripts.check: concurrently --group --names biome,desktop:tsc,desktop:test,sidecar:test,rust,companion,website --prefix-colors auto "bun run check:biome" "bun run check:desktop:tsc" "bun run check:desktop:test" "bun run check:sidecar:test" "bun run check:rust" "bun run check:companion" "bun run check:website"
scripts.check:rust: concurrently --group --max-processes 1 --names rust:clippy,rust:test,tauri:build,drift --prefix-colors auto "bun run check:rust:clippy" "bun run check:rust:test" "bun run check:tauri:build" "bun run check:drift"
scripts.check:drift: cd apps/desktop && cargo xtask regen-protocol && cd ../.. && git diff --exit-code -- apps/companion/src/modules/wss/protocol.gen.ts
scripts.check:fix: biome check --write --unsafe && cd apps/desktop && cargo clippy --all-targets --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged
